description_en: Retrieves information about Data Modeling objects created by using fast modeling language (FML) statements
description_zh: 使用FML语句查询数据建模引擎的信息
name: QueryPublicModelEngine

parameters.help_en: The FML statement that is used to query information about objects that are created in Data Modeling. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/298128.html. Only SHOW statements are supported
parameters.help_zh:
输入查询引擎信息的FML语句，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/298128.html。
当前仅支持show语句
parameters.name: text

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID
parameters.name: project_id

schema.description_zh: 是调用FML语句查询返回的结果

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

ReturnValue.description_zh: 是通过FML语句查询返回的列表信息

items.description_en: The returned information about the object
items.description_zh: 返回通过FML语句查询的数据建模引擎信息的结果
items.example: [{ "gmtModified": 最后修改时间,"code": "表名","creatorId": "创建人ID","creatorName": "创建人名称","modifierId": "修改人ID","gmtCreate": 创建时间,"type": 表类型,"ownerId": "负责人ID","uuid": "系统ID","businessUnitUuid": "业务板块ID","detailType": "表二级类型","ownerName": "负责人名称","name": "表显示名","modifierName": "最后修改人名称","businessProcessUuid": "业务过程ID" 	}]
